blurb: Candidate: AI Product Engineer and solo founder in Saudi Arabia who builds and deploys LLM-powered products and production automations end to end. Founder of Watheq, a private-beta bilingual AI resume optimization and job-matching platform for the Saudi market, built solo with React 19, TypeScript, Netlify Functions, Supabase/PostgreSQL with row-level security, Upstash Redis rate limiting, OpenRouter/Gemini, and server-side PDF generation. He builds evidence-constrained LLM workflows for parsing, matching, gap analysis, interview questions, and resume improvement, with Zod validation, anti-hallucination output rules, gold-set evaluation harnesses, deterministic scoring, and quality-drift checks. He built bilingual PDF/DOCX processing with Arabic/English detection, OCR fallback, structured JSON recovery, real-time progress, and ATS-safe PDF exports. He also runs production automation on GitHub Actions: a Saudi job-discovery and ranking pipeline across five ATS APIs with fail-soft discovery, employer verification, apply-link recovery, quota controls, evidence-aware ranking, and Discord delivery. His TASI market-analysis platform combines Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, deterministic technical rules, scheduled workflows, Discord alerts, a 5-year walk-forward backtest, provider failover, and CI contract tests. Python, TypeScript, and SQL, with 6+ years in commercial operations and data analysis and hands-on AI product engineering since 2025. Native Arabic and professional English. Wants senior individual-contributor AI/LLM, software, and data-analytics roles based in Saudi Arabia only; roles based outside Saudi Arabia are not a match even with relocation. He prefers hands-on technical ownership and not people management. EDUCATION: diploma in Pipefitting Technology from Saudi Petroleum Services Polytechnic (2018), GPA 4.6/5, and NO bachelor's degree. Everything in software and AI is self-taught and shipped rather than credentialed. A posting that states a bachelor's degree as a minimum qualification is a real gap; a degree that is preferred or accepts equivalent experience is not. WHAT HE DOES NOT DO: he BUILDS WITH models, he does not build models. Do not credit model training, fine-tuning, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, deep learning, MLOps, feature engineering, or formal statistics/data-science study. His evaluation work judge-scores LLM prompts and model variants, not models he trained. A posting requiring model development, fine-tuning, or a classical ML stack is a wrong-function match and belongs in the 0-39 band.
